content.title: Los Angeles Dodgers vs Colorado Rockies Live Stream: How to Watch MLB
content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers and Colorado Rockies will meet in Game 3 of their four-game series on Sunday afternoon in Denver. The Los Angeles Dodgers will continue a seven-game road trip in Denver on Sunday afternoon as they play Game 3 of four at T-Mobile Park against the Rockies. The Dodgers come into the game with a record of 15-5 so far in the season, which has them sitting in first place in the National League West standings. The Rockies are now sitting in last place in the National League West standings, holding a record of 8-13 after dropping the opening game in the series and winning the second. While the season is still young, the teams will both look to tack on a win on Sunday afternoon to gain some momentum before starting a fresh series early in the week. Saturday’s game between the two teams resulted in a 4-3 victory for the Rockies which was credited to Brennan Bernardino after he threw for 1.1 innings and struck out two batters. Colorado was led offensively by Troy Johnston, who went 3-for-4 at the plate with two RBIs after hitting a two-run double to center field in the bottom of the sixth, bringing home the game-winning run in the process. While Ryan Feltner gave up two home runs in the start for Colorado, the bullpen was ready and came through to pick up the win. The Dodgers were led offensively by Kyle Tucker, who went 3-for-5 at the plate with two RBIs, smashing a two-run shot to right center in the top of the first to give Los Angeles an early lead. Dalton Rushing also hit a home run, his fifth of the season, in the top of the second, but that’s where the scoring stopped for L.A. and the team was forced to take a loss. Will Klein was credited with the loss after giving up two earned runs in one inning on the mound. Los Angeles will put the ball in Roki Sasaki’s hand on Sunday afternoon. Sasaki is still in search of his first win of the season, as he comes in at 0-2 with an ERA of 6.23 and 15 strikeouts.
